FAQ

Dashboard questions, answered.

What is the DigiPromise client dashboard?

It is your private online dashboard where you see every conversation your AI agent has had, every lead it captured and the chats it handed to your team.

Which plans include the dashboard?

Growth and above include the client dashboard. Enterprise can get a custom dashboard. Starter does not include the dashboard.

Can I download my leads?

Yes. Export your leads as a CSV file for the last 30 days, 90 days or 12 months.

Can I change what my agent says?

Yes. Review any conversation and send us the change. Our team updates your agent for you.

Is my data secure?

Your data is only used to run your agent and your dashboard. We never sell it, and you can ask us to export or delete it at any time.
